title: MC More Beautiful
description: This is a Modpack packed with many mods that make Minecraft 10x better than before.
body:
![Minecraft More Beautiful](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62f71f7834f2ff9b52088bd3c6bf4894c4c8298d_0.webp)

**MC More Beautiful is a modpack made to make Minecraft work like normal, but give it a little more details and things to look at.**

This modpack includes many mods that make minecraft look and feel more beautiful. Inside you'll find many mods that change textures and how certain blocks look, many performance improving mods are included as well, that will make minecraft run better than before.

The purpose is to help people easily achieve this new beautiful look with mods that you don't have to add manually. Just download this pack and you are good to go.
